title: Tax Graph Decision Node
description: A first-class point where human judgment is required. The agent presents the question and options grounded in citations; it never makes the interpretive ruling itself. Every decision MUST offer an escape hatch (other / unsupported / escalate) so a filer is never forced into a wrong choice ('incomplete, but never wrong').

sets_node.description: Optional: the fact node this decision resolves.

question.description: What the agent asks the filer.

citation_refs.description: The governing authority. A decision may cite many sources.

options.description: The choices. Must include at least one escape option (option_type other/unsupported/escalate).

option_type.description: 'choice' = a substantive answer; the others are escape hatches.

sets.description: Fact/value assigned, or branch activated, if chosen.
